# Docs

- Home
  - [Home](/)
- SDKs
  - [SDKs](/sdks): Client libraries for this API.
  - [TypeScript SDK](/sdks/typescript): Install and start using the TypeScript SDK.
  - [Python SDK](/sdks/python): Install and start using the Python SDK.
- API Reference
  - System: Health and configuration monitoring endpoints
    - [Health & Configuration Status](/api/openapi/system/getHealth): Returns service operational status, active data mode (sandbox vs fixture), dry run safety flag, and order/dispute statistics.
  - Disputes: PayPal dispute retrieval, evidence pack compilation, and scoring
    - [List All Disputes](/api/openapi/disputes/listDisputes): Retrieves all active PayPal customer disputes enriched with matched store order data,
indexed Evidence Packs, deterministic winnability scores, and live deadline calculations.
Results are sorted ascending by response deadline.
    - [Reset Demo Dispute Database](/api/openapi/disputes/resetDisputesDemo): Resets mock fixture disputes back to their initial active state (6 active disputes, clearing test concessions/refunds).
    - [Get Single Dispute Details](/api/openapi/disputes/getDisputeById): Fetches full details for a specific dispute, including its store order match, evidence pack facts, score breakdown, and cached AI analysis.
  - A I: Grounded defense drafting and citation analysis via Gemini
    - [Generate or Refresh Gemini AI Defense Analysis](/api/openapi/ai/analyzeDispute): Invokes Google Gemini to evaluate the dispute and Evidence Pack.
Produces structured JSON containing strategic recommendation (FIGHT / ACCEPT / PARTIAL_OFFER),
summary, and a factual draft defense strictly citing Evidence Pack fact IDs ([F1], [F2]).
Validates all citations against the Evidence Pack and caches the output locally.
  - Actions: Merchant-approved PayPal dispute actions (evidence submission, claim acceptance, settlement offers)
    - [Submit Evidence to PayPal](/api/openapi/actions/submitEvidence): Submits merchant evidence statement to PayPal Disputes API v1 (`POST /v1/customer/disputes/{id}/provide-evidence`).
If `DRY_RUN=true`, validates and logs the payload in the audit trail without modifying live account state.
    - [Accept Dispute Claim](/api/openapi/actions/acceptClaim): Concedes liability and accepts the customer claim via PayPal Disputes API v1 (`POST /v1/customer/disputes/{id}/accept-claim`).
Authorizes full refund to buyer. If `DRY_RUN=true`, validates and records action without sending network mutation.
    - [Propose Partial Settlement Offer](/api/openapi/actions/makeOffer): Submits a partial refund settlement offer to the buyer via PayPal Disputes API v1 (`POST /v1/customer/disputes/{id}/make-offer`).
If `DRY_RUN=true`, validates offer amount and records action in audit trail without live mutation.
  - Audit: Chronological merchant action logging and audit trail
    - [Retrieve Merchant Audit Trail](/api/openapi/audit/getActivityLog): Returns the chronological, immutable log of merchant actions, submitted evidence statements, and settlement decisions.
